title: Hydraulic ironworkers
subtitle: Q35Y five-station steelworkers 55 – 276 US tons · punching, flat bar, angle, bar and section shearing, notching
cover_line: NovoTech value line · built in China to North American standards · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_title: Five stations, one machine, tooling included
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification with European and Japanese controls and hydraulics — Delem, Estun, Hawe, Rexroth, Schneider, Siemens, NOK — inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with the same CSA-approved panel, 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, as every machine we sell.

The Q35Y puts the five jobs of the structural shop on one hydraulic cylinder: punching, flat-bar shear, angle shear at 90° and 45°, round and square bar shear and rectangular notching, each with its own hold-down and guard — and the punch, dies and blade sets are in the crate. Seven models from the compact 55 US ton bench machine to the 276 ton Q35Y-250 that punches Ø1-9/16″ through 1-9/16″ plate and shears 7-7/8″ angle, 12″ channel and 2″ flat bar.
made_in: Built in China to North American standards
